purpose: DWP Stat-Xplore, households sent a Move to Universal Credit migration notice in Great Britain, notices July 2022 to June 2026, by the legacy benefits they received and their move status (claimed Universal Credit, did not claim as the legacy benefit closed, in progress), with the totals by combination and by status (uk-data#534, microcosm#1095): the uc_legacy_closure_take_up stage's claim rate for a combination is claimed / (claimed + did not claim). No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
